name: How long does Hometelligent Inc. warranty deck railing installations?

mainEntity.name: How long does Hometelligent Inc. warranty deck railing installations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent Inc. provides a warranty on our deck railing installations, covering both workmanship and structural integrity. The specific terms and duration of the warranty will be clearly outlined in your project contract. Additionally, the materials we install often come with separate manufacturer warranties, providing further peace of mind for your investment. We prioritize quality and stand by our work, ensuring customer satisfaction in all our service areas including Albany and Piedmont.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hometelligent Inc. warranties workmanship and structural integrity; specific terms are in the project contract, plus manufacturer material warranties.
